senses.gloss: (cmp. חָזָה) to expose to sight, uncover. Part. pass. f. שְׁחוּזָה; pl. שְׁחוּזוֹת.
units: Sabb. V, 2 רחלות יוצאות ש׳ ewes (on the Sabbath) may be led out (with their posteriors) exposed; ib. 53ᵇ מאי שח̇וז̇ות שאוח̇ז̇ין וכ׳ what is sh’ḥuzoth? They tie their tails up in order &c. Ib. מאי משמע דהאי ש׳ לישנא דגלוי הוא what evidence is there that sh’ḥuzoth has the meaning of uncovering? (Answ. ref. to שׁית זוֹנה, Prov. VII, 10, v. שׁוּזָה.)
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:5">Kel. XIV, 5</cite> <he>הסכין משיַשְׁחִיזֶנָּה</he> the knife becomes susceptible of levitical uncleanness, when he (the manufacturer) polishes it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:3">Ḥull. II, 3</cite> <he>ה׳ … ועף וכ׳</he> if one whetted the knife and (in beginning to cut) felt tired, and another person continued the cutting.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:7">Bets. III, 7</cite> <he>אין מַשְׁחִיזִין וכ׳</he> you must not whet the knife (to slaughter on the Holy Day), but &c., v. <cite ref="N01284"><he>נָשָׂא</he></cite>. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ bot. <he>אין מוכרין … ואין משחיזין וכ׳</he> you must not sell them (the gentiles in Palestine) weapons or armor, nor may you sharpen weapons for them; a. fr.
